summary: Iter15 - top-of-book edges, dynamic volatility stop, book-share cap, breakeven_floor, stop_mode toggle. Backend pytest 6/6 passed. /api/spreads items all have numeric long_edge_pct & short_edge_pct with invariant 'at most one > 0' upheld across all 10 coins; vol_pct number|null; recommended_stop_pct numeric; stop_basis in {dynamic, fixed, fixed (warming up)} and 0.15<=rec_stop<=1.0 when basis=='dynamic'. /api/config defaults verified: stop_mode='dynamic', vol_k=2, stop_min_pct=0.15, stop_max_pct=1.0, max_book_share_pct=25, breakeven_floor=true, vol_window_s=300. PUT {stop_mode:'banana'}->422. PUT {vol_k:3, max_book_share_pct:40}->200 GET reflects; restored to 2 / 25. /api/positions/closed?limit=3 items include stop_pct & stop_basis keys. /api/compare returns exchanges={coinswitch,coindcx} (both laggards vs Binance leader) each with verdict. No restricted endpoints were called; bot left LIVE with stop_mode=dynamic, vol_k=2, max_book_share_pct=25.
